description: Use when an agent needs what a company's insiders bought and sold. Returns one row per transaction from the company's recent SEC Form 4 filings: insider, role, transaction code and meaning, shares, price, value, shares owned after and date, plus open-market buy and sale totals for the window. Source: SEC EDGAR Form 4 filings. Costs 0.01 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

ticker.description: a US-listed ticker, e.g. NVDA, TSLA
